sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: brings a clean fruit identity. It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite. Easy to use as a whole food. Simple, recognisable, and realistic for everyday eating. Hydrating whole-fruit package. Water and whole-food structure make it easier to use well than juice or sweets.
